shortDescription: Shares of Zentalis Pharmaceuticals NASDAQ:ZNTL gained on Monday after the cancer drug developer announced mid-stage trial data indicating that its lead asset, azenosertib, extended survival in a subset of patients with ovarian cancer.The DENALI Phase 2 potentially registrational trial was designed…

children: gained on Monday after the cancer drug developer announced mid-stage trial data indicating that its lead asset, azenosertib, extended survival in a subset of patients with ovarian cancer.

The DENALI Phase 2 potentially registrational trial was designed to evaluate the oral therapy as a late-line monotherapy in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer regardless of their cyclin E1 protein expression.

Citing a Sept. 2 data cut from Part 1b of DENALI, the San Diego, California-based biotech said on Sunday that patients in the Cyclin E1-positive subgroup had a median OS of 15.8 months in response to azenosertib compared with 7.5 months in the Cyclin E1-negative subgroup.

There were no new safety signals, according to the data posted as an abstract ahead of a rapid oral presentation scheduled at this year’s European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress on Friday.

The company said that the results, which identified cyclin E1 as a critical biomarker for response to azenosertib, support further studies into the WEE1 inhibitor in that PROC patient group in its ongoing DENALI Part 2 and ASPENOVA Phase

title: Zentalis rises as lead asset extends survival in mid-stage trial for ovarian cancer
